name: Météo-France: Vigilance

frame.part: top of the page, no scrolling

capture_note: Captured by incident.archivist@ (evidence meteofrance-fr/2026/11/11/0253-fr) and kept privately: the site's terms do not clearly allow showing a screenshot, so the frame stays empty and the link stands.
licence_for_showing_the_screenshot: Météo-France public data is under the French open licence (not re-read here): the archivist confirms before the screenshot is shown.
summary: One card that carries everything a warning needs: when issued, until when valid, when the next comes, the map, a legend written as actions, and a bar per hazard along the day.

callouts.title: Issued, and valid until
callouts.does_well: "émise le 10 novembre 2026 à 16h00 … valable jusqu'au 12 novembre 2026 à 00h00": two times under the title.

callouts.title: Today, tomorrow, and when the next map comes
callouts.does_well: Two tabs; tomorrow's is grey and says "Prochaine carte à 06h".
callouts.fed_by: next_read_utc of each file; IPMA's communiqué validity

callouts.title: One colour per département
callouts.does_well: The whole country at a glance, with the Paris area enlarged in an inset.
callouts.fed_by: our own redraw from IPMA's JSON

callouts.title: A legend of actions
callouts.does_well: "Vigilance absolue", "Soyez très vigilant", "Soyez attentif", "Pas de vigilance particulière": each colour is what to do.
callouts.fed_by: IPMA's and ANEPC's own wording for each level, quoted

callouts.title: Maps per phenomenon
callouts.does_well: A list of the hazards in force ("Orages"); choosing one redraws the map for it.

callouts.title: A bar per hazard along the day
callouts.does_well: Hours 0h to 0h across; one bar per phenomenon, coloured for the hours it applies. Floods link to the river service.

callouts.title: The rhythm, stated
callouts.does_well: "Les cartes de vigilance météo sont actualisées au moins 2 fois par jour à 6h et 16h."
callouts.fed_by: how often each file is read (next_read_utc)

callouts.title: A PDF version
callouts.does_well: The same card as a document to forward.
callouts.fed_by: the page's markdown twin and api/v1
